overview.en:
Inspect visitor feature flags and campaign configuration with AB Tasty’s official Feature Experimentation MCP.

Review experiment or feature-release context before proposing a change. Identify the environment and audience, then separate observed configuration and results from recommendations.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 AB Tasty 官方 Feature Experimentation MCP 查看访客功能开关与实验活动配置。

在提出变更前查看实验或功能发布上下文。明确环境与受众，区分当前配置、观测结果和建议。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Review the available experiments or feature settings for this environment.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看这个环境中的可用实验或功能配置。

starterPrompts.en: Explain how this experiment or release is targeted to users.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 解释这个实验或发布如何定向到用户。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a review of this experiment or feature rollout before changing it.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 在修改前，准备这项实验或功能发布的审查说明。

descriptions.en: Use AB Tasty Feature Experimentation in Ghast. Inspect visitor feature flags and campaign configuration with AB Tasty’s official Feature Experimentation MCP. 通过 AB Tasty 官方 Feature Experimentation MCP 查看访客功能开关与实验活动配置。
